name: maqsy-chat-runtime
description: Isolated project for the lazy-loaded AI chat bundle (React 19 + @shadcn/react + TypeScript). Its source lives under chat-runtime/src and is compiled from here (not the plugin root) so normal node_modules resolution finds React 19 naturally, without needing tsconfig path hacks. Kept separate from the plugin root's node_modules because @wordpress/babel-preset-default hard-pins React 18 for wp-scripts' own build tooling, which would otherwise conflict with @shadcn/react's React >=19 peer requirement. The root package.json's esbuild scripts point at chat-runtime/src/chat-launcher/index.ts as their entry, and esbuild resolves its imports from chat-runtime/node_modules since that's the nearest node_modules on disk.
